name: smwmusic-thinkonemoretime-fabulous-gardens-styla-remix
title: ThinkOneMoreTime - Fabulous Gardens ~ Styla (Remix)
description:
Did a sampled arrangement of the catchy SMW Composition by ThinkOneMoreTime, Styla. By far one of my favorite songs on the site, and it's been almost 8 years since hearing this banger in some good ol' hacks!

This baby can fit athletic / sky stages, night, mountain, and space stages.

Important:
There is a "!READ ME.txt" file that has the sample bank. You'll need to move what's in that file into "Addmusic_sample_groups.txt."
- "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also 4 customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. A# Minor (Remix Pitch, turned on default)
2. A Minor (Original Pitch)
3. G# Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
4. B Minor (Custom Pitch 2)
